overloadMerges.note: Records rowNum's documented negative-constant sentinels (from QR Rows for Properties) and property's 10 documented text-attribute constants (from QR Text Properties) as sentinelValues instead of bare Integers.

params.name: colNum
params.description: Column number of the cell; still required even when rowNum is qr header (-4) or qr footer (-5), even though it is unused in that case

params.name: rowNum
params.description: Row designator: a positive subtotal (break) level, or one of the documented constants (in cross-table mode, row values are always positive)

sentinelValues.meaning: qr detail - detail area of report
qr grand total - grand total area
_o_qr font - obsolete since 4D v14 R3 (use qr font name)
qr font size - font size in points (9 to 255)
qr bold - bold style attribute (0 or 1)
qr italic - italic style attribute (0 or 1)
qr underline - underline style attribute (0 or 1)
qr text color - color number attribute (Longint)
qr background color - background color number
qr alternate background color - alternate background color number
qr font name - font name, as returned e.g. by FONT LIST

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the value of one text-formatting attribute (property) for the cell at (colNum, rowNum) in a Quick Report area; returns an Integer or Text depending on which property was requested.

jointConstraints.rule: When rowNum is qr header (-4) or qr footer (-5), colNum must still be passed even though its value is not used.
